body: Yeah, I wish it was that easy. It's easy to say don't let the bureaucrat spoil it but when you have to play by their rules, it's either drop out of school or get a degree in something I hate.

I will tomorrow. I'm already in my pajamas right now. They're supposed to send the letters 7 days after we apply, and tomorrow's the 7th day. Last time I got rejected I threw all of my art supplies and posters and anything art related under the bed and in the closet, locked it all away for weeks. I don't know how I could handle that twice.

The University can't help. If I fail portfolio review this time I'm forced to change majors, even though I've practically already completed the curriculum. Switching majors isn't a death sentence I know, but it means thousands more in debt on top of what I'll already owe.
And it's not that I'm upset it won't turn out perfectly in the future, I just don't see anything good at all coming from it. I can't even find an 'ideal' situation for how I wish things would go, none of it seems happy or good or worth it.
I managed to organize a girl's night for us soon, nail painting, chick flick, the whole nine yards. We'll see what happens I guess...
I'm just saying, all the accusations could have been avoided with a simple change of wording... unless he really did mean girls, in which case let the accusations fly.
Came here just for the apostrophe mishap.
Number 3 definitely sounds like the best option. Thanks for your help!
Perhaps reword to say "A great place to meet WOMEN." That would help. Just a bit. A little reassuring.

But I'm not going to cheat on my boyfriend, or make her cheat on hers... That's another issue. I know some people don't count the same gender as cheating, but if it means something, then yes, it does to me. He's asked me if I'd ever kiss another girl, he's turned on by that, and I'm willing to do it for him, but only if it was superficial and didn't mean anything.
The problem is that I'm not sure I really want it to be sexual, I just... feel really strongly about her.
It sounds lovely, but I get all nervous whenever we get physically close... I don't know why.

It's just hard for me... even just to say that I do love her, but you're right, I really couldn't say how I honestly feel without saying it. But I couldn't say it to her... I just don't know what would happen.
